Maya: Quick q — need an audit export for a customer incident (who did what) across the last 7 days. Who can run this and what's the expected format/redaction?
Ajay: You can get a pre-redacted Parquet/CSV from the audit exports pipeline. Steps: open a security ticket with justification + affected customer, security approves, then eng-ops runs export to s3://redwood-audit-exports/<ticket>.
Maya: who's in eng-ops? and do we need legal?
Elena: eng-ops owners are @Sam and @Elena. Legal only if the request is for >1 year retention or includes raw customer PII (unhashed email/SSN). For incident troubleshooting (last 7–90 days) security approval is usually sufficient.
Sam: I can run it. We use the audit-export-service; default export = Parquet with the standard redaction profile. Example query we run for a timeframe:
```
SELECT event_ts, actor_id, action, resource_type, resource_id, ip_addr
FROM audit_events
WHERE event_ts >= '2026-03-01' AND event_ts < '2026-03-08';
```
Elena: Redaction details — fields removed/obfuscated by default: `email`, `full_name`, `client_secret`, `auth_token`. `actor_id` is salted-hash. IPs are masked to /24 (last octet zeroed). If you need reversible identifiers for legal, that's an escalated flow requiring legal + CISO signoff.
Ajay: Retention/exports: canonical audit store kept hot for 180 days, then archived (cold) for up to 3 years with legal approval. Ad-hoc exports are written to a time-limited S3 path and ACL'd to security only; include the ticket number in the path so we can trace it back.
Maya: Do we have a runbook for the request/approval flow?
Elena: Yep — internal runbook: https://internal.redwood.com/runbooks/audit-exports — follow "Ad-hoc export" section. It lists who to ping, required justification text, and the redaction profiles.
Sam: Operational note: when you create the ticket, include affected customer id, approximate event window, and the reason (incident triage). I will then kick off the export and paste the s3 path here.
support: Creating ticket SEC-2026-451 for Maya — assigned to security for approval.
security-bot: Export job queued by Sam — job id export-20260310-004. ETA ~6m.
Maya: thanks — will update the incident with the ticket. :thumbsup:
Ajay: FYI if you need CSV instead of Parquet we can do that but it increases size and runtime, expect longer ETA.
Maya: good to know. tagging @Sam to proceed once SEC-2026-451 is approved.
Sam: ack — will watch the ticket and run once approved.
Maya: appreciate it — will close the loop here when I have the path.
